name: Cheat The Chess
summary: Cheat the Chess! Learn by beating Stockfish 19. Play offline, use whispered hints and undo mistakes. 10 difficulty levels, 5 skill-building mini-games, 12 unlockable themes, Daily Puzzle, Lichess online, hand tracking, MR/VR, lying-down mode, custom shaders and more. Lose? Smash the board!
